note: 3D bodies for Crosshaven's NPCs (art kit, art/3d/npcs/chr_<model>). city: the city.json NPC id -> model. extra: role NPCs added by the 3D city (post = a place name from city_life3d). folk: models for the strolling townsfolk. Each model's JSON gives its clips and behaviour (route text -> waypoints round its post, work idles). The kit's story-NPC cells (Guide 24,18; Banker 20,20; Herald 17,19) are Crossroads cells in npcs.json; inside the walled city the story NPCs keep their city.json posts.
